name: AgentSEO REST API
description: Production REST API for Google SERP analysis, keyword research, rank tracking, content-gap analysis, and Google AI Overview monitoring for SEO and answer-engine optimization workflows.
notes: AgentSEO is a paid API with 100 one-time live credits for new accounts; ongoing usage requires a paid plan. It is a strong fit for this directory because AI agents and developers can use its structured SEO and AEO data for search visibility workflows.
